description: Fork of exp513 (qk nap=4/tph=256, NO v-branch, v_lut nap=6/tph=320 = 1.4825). ONLY change: v_lut DEEPER -- nap 6->8, tph 320->128 (2^nap*tph: 64*320=20480 -> 256*128=32768; v_lut params 1.97M->3.15M, +1.18M). Clean test (no v-branch confound) of whether v_lut prefers DEEP: exp524 (wide-shallow v_lut nap=4/tph=1024) lost ~24mb, suggesting v_lut wants the opposite of qk. nap=8 = 256 rows x 128 tables. vs exp513 1.4825 (nap6), exp524 (nap4, ~1.50+).
